text:
Type: white eyelet curtains, one pair
Use: dressing a window, filtering daylight and adding privacy; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, classic
Materials: heavy woven cotton-look fabric, metal eyelets along the header
Colors: soft white, silver eyelets
Shape: two long straight panels hanging in deep even folds from a rod threaded through ring eyelets, smooth plain weave, full length, soft but substantial
Feel: clean, bright, calm, airy
Goes with: light wood, grey sofas, linen, white walls; Scandinavian, minimalist or classic rooms

product.name: MERETE
product.description: The thick curtains darken the room and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing into the room.
